import pytest

from fizzbuzz import fizzbuzz  # Adjust this import if your module name differs


LARGE = 10**12


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param(1, "1", id="not-divisible-by-3-or-5"),
        pytest.param(3, "Fizz", id="divisible-by-3"),
        pytest.param(6, "Fizz", id="another-divisible-by-3"),
        pytest.param(5, "Buzz", id="divisible-by-5"),
        pytest.param(10, "Buzz", id="another-divisible-by-5"),
        pytest.param(15, "FizzBuzz", id="divisible-by-3-and-5"),
        pytest.param(30, "FizzBuzz", id="another-divisible-by-3-and-5"),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_happy_path(n, expected):
    assert fizzbuzz(n) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param(0, "FizzBuzz", id="zero"),
        pytest.param(-1, "-1", id="negative-not-divisible"),
        pytest.param(-3, "Fizz", id="negative-divisible-by-3"),
        pytest.param(-5, "Buzz", id="negative-divisible-by-5"),
        pytest.param(-15, "FizzBuzz", id="negative-divisible-by-3-and-5"),
        pytest.param(LARGE, "Buzz", id="large-divisible-by-5"),
        pytest.param(15 * LARGE, "FizzBuzz", id="large-divisible-by-3-and-5"),
        pytest.param(LARGE + 1, str(LARGE + 1), id="large-not-divisible"),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_edge_cases(n, expected):
    assert fizzbuzz(n) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_value",
    [
        None,
        "15",
        [15],
        {"n": 15},
        object(),
    ],
    ids=["none", "string", "list", "dict", "object"],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_raises_type_error_for_unsupported_inputs(bad_value):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        fizzbuzz(bad_value)
